ABSTRACT 
In one example , a system for embedded image management 
includes a blade enclosure that includes a set of server 
blades , an embedded image management appliance coupled 
to the blade enclosure , comprising : an image repository 
stored in a memory resource , an appliance operating system 
that operates on the memory resource , and an image 
resource manager that operates on the appliance operating 
system .
